template: Create a new asset in Snipe-IT (Assets -> Create New / Create Asset) with these values: Asset Name = '{{v2}}', Model = '{{v3}}' (must be selected from the searchable dropdown's suggestion list, not just typed), Status = 'Ready to Deploy' (select the status label from the dropdown), Default Location = 'Bench Office' (select from the dropdown), Purchase Date = {{v4}}. Fill any other required fields as needed but do not create new models, locations, or users. Save the asset, then open the asset's page and report the asset tag Snipe-IT assigned (format like BA-00012), plus the name, model, status, location and purchase date as displayed.

provenance.instruction: Create a new asset in Snipe-IT (Assets -> Create New / Create Asset) with these values: Asset Name = 'fwsi9-n3 Bench Asset', Model = 'Bench Laptop Model' (must be selected from the searchable dropdown's suggestion list, not just typed), Status = 'Ready to Deploy' (select the status label from the dropdown), Default Location = 'Bench Office' (select from the dropdown), Purchase Date = 2026-03-15. Fill any other required fields as needed but do not create new models, locations, or users. Save the asset, then open the asset's page and report the asset tag Snipe-IT assigned (format like BA-00012), plus the name, model, status, location and purchase date as displayed.
